purpose: Exact visual recreation handoff for manually rebuilding the seven static bridal concept sites in Wix Studio.
sourceOfTruth: The corresponding static HTML route is authoritative for content, section order, image crop, component arrangement, and interaction. This specification records tokens and layout behavior for a manual Wix Studio recreation.
fidelityTarget: Match each HTML source at the reference viewport sizes after a side-by-side visual QA pass; do not substitute a shared template or merely recolor it.

globalDesignTokens.heroTitle: clamp(42px, 5.3vw, 76px), line-height 1.04; per-concept overrides are stored below
globalDesignTokens.imageFit: cover; preserve each source image and the per-concept object-position values
globalDesignTokens.note: Translate clamp()/min()/max() values at each reference viewport when configuring Wix breakpoints; use Wix Studio responsive sizing or equivalent per-breakpoint values.

wixNativeComponentMapping.wrap: Container with max width 1180px and matching side gutters
wixNativeComponentMapping.heroGridAndEditorialLayouts: Wix Studio CSS Grid / responsive stacks; exact column ratios are recorded in concept CSS rules
wixNativeComponentMapping.cardsAndSteps: Repeater or container grid with individual card styling
wixNativeComponentMapping.faq: Native accordion / collapsible items, matching open/closed typography and borders
wixNativeComponentMapping.images: Wix Media Manager images, original supplied assets, exact crop/position from source CSS
wixNativeComponentMapping.enquiry: Native Wix Form mapped to the source fields; preserve concept-specific select choices and anchor target
wixNativeComponentMapping.language: Wix Multilingual; replace the static prototype translation widget
wixNativeComponentMapping.navigation: Native menu with concept-specific visible labels and route mappings
wixNativeComponentMapping.footer: Native section with exact Jobshore credit, email, and concept disclosure
